title: Exercise recorder silence through real caller paths and coalescing boundaries
outcome: Behavioral tests detect recording regressions in actual idle/predicate callers and outside-hold or later-window coalescing, without source-text pins or real waiting.
acceptance: Real relay-row, monitor/supervisor, mirror and directory-context scenarios discriminate quiet checks from extra refusal observations or inflated counts.
Observable refusal sequences cover consecutive versus non-consecutive outside-hold events, durable=true repeats and distinct later hold windows with bounded records.
Tests use controlled IO/time or existing phase synchronization, preserving authority/transport behavior and avoiding source-text or Markdown assertions.
